description: Retrieve a complete workflow definition by name. When version is omitted, returns the highest available version. Also returns optional global execution guidance to apply when running the workflow, or null when none is configured. Template placeholders like {{input.foo}} in step params are opaque strings, returned verbatim. Temporary workflows are accessible here but excluded from workflow_list.

name.description: Exact workflow name to retrieve. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored; a blank name is rejected.

version.description: Specific semver version to retrieve (e.g. "1.0.0"). Must be valid semver; surrounding whitespace, a leading "v", and build metadata are ignored, so "v1.0.0" retrieves 1.0.0. Omit to get the highest available version.

name: workflow_get

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: No workflow matches the given name. `version_not_found`: Name exists but the specific version does not. `index_unavailable`: The workflow index has not finished building yet. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

globalInstructions.description: Optional global execution guidance to apply when running the workflow, or null when none is configured.

source.description: Whether this is a permanent or temporary workflow.

steps.description: Ordered steps to execute in sequence.

items.description: A single step in the workflow: server, tool, and optional params/metadata.

forEach.description: Iteration expression (opaque string, not executed server-side).

name.description: Step name (if provided in the workflow).

params.description: Key-value parameter map; may contain {{input.foo}} placeholders.

temporary.description: True if this is a temporary workflow.

title: Get Workflow
